notes: Drawphone (Express + Socket.IO + pug, jQuery front end bundled by webpack). Node 16.20.2 via mise; deps installed with `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --ignore-scripts` (npm's resolver loops forever on ml5's tfjs peer deps without the flag; tarballs were prefetched through .ui-capture/tarball-mirror.cjs because the sandbox proxy kept resetting connections), then `npm run build:prod`. start.sh runs .ui-capture/server.mjs, which mirrors server/bin/www.js, mounts the stubs in front of the unmodified app, and serves on $PORT. No app source files were changed. DATA: Drawphone keeps a player's history only in the browser (IndexedDB 'DrawphoneDatabase', Dexie schema from client/archive.js). On the first page load in a browser, .ui-capture/seed/seed-archive.js bulk-adds .ui-capture/seed/archive.json into that same Dexie table, then loads the real app bundle (a localStorage flag keeps it to once). archive.json is built by `node .ui-capture/seed/generate-archive.mjs`: 89 past games / 527 chains (Mar 14 to Nov 15 2026; Friday/Saturday game nights with 1-4 rounds, weekday work-lunch games, a family night with Grandpa Joe and Aunt Linda), 4-9 players each, pack-word and 'players write first word' rounds with inside-joke prompts, chains that follow the server's length rules (always end on a word), guesses that drift and include typos/caps/joke answers, and drawings stored as data:image/svg+xml;base64 fabric.js toSVG output (hand-jittered doodles, per-player colour/brush habits, different canvas sizes per device). The local user plays as 'Sam'. MAIN AREAS: /archive = 'Your Previous Results' list grouped by date, click one to see results (#1..#n chains with drawings, 'You started with / ended up with'); / = main menu (announcement, Join Party / Start Party, View Previous Results, How to Play); Join Party prefills code 'kiwi' to enter the friends' lobby (players list, host-controlled options); Start Party creates your own game where you're host (word pack, time limit, turns, add bots, Start Game -> drawing canvas with color/size/undo, guessing, waiting screen, results); /how-to-play.
